title: Nimble Norwegian Salmon Tacos
description: A quick, cultured salmon taco that pairs Norwegian salmon with Mediterranean flavors in crisp hard shells. Light, savory, and ready in minutes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Season the salmon strips with smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper.
Cook the salmon until opaque and slightly caramelized, about 3-4 minutes, then remove from heat.
Squeeze lemon juice over the salmon and stir to combine.
Warm the hard taco shells according to package instructions, about 1 minute.
Spread a thin layer of Greek yogurt on each shell.
Add a handful of mixed greens, a few salmon strips, sliced red onion, dill, and capers to each shell.
Fold the tacos loosely and serve immediately.
Optional: garnish with extra dill or a squeeze of lemon before serving.
Enjoy your quick, Mediterranean-friendly Norwegian salmon tacos.
